title: About Us
seo_title: About Us | Grow Green Weed Control – Firefighter-Owned Lawn Experts
seo_desc: Grow Green Weed Control is a firefighter-owned lawn care company serving Baton Rouge and surrounding areas with expert weed control and fertilization services.
headings: Built on service, responsibility and doing the job right.
We do not try to be every kind of lawn company.
Clear from the first quote to every treatment after it.
Meet your local Grow Green team.
South Louisiana is not an easy place to grow great turf.
Let’s take a closer look at your property.
paragraphs: Grow Green was built to give local homeowners something better: lawn treatments designed for our climate, dependable people who show up, and clear communication after every visit.
Dereck Palermo founded Grow Green Weed Control with a straightforward idea: South Louisiana homeowners deserved reliable lawn care from a local team that would take ownership of the result.

As a professional firefighter, Dereck built the company around the same habits his other career demands—show up prepared, pay attention to details, communicate clearly and be accountable when people count on you.

What began as one local owner serving his neighbors has grown into a dedicated team caring for hundreds of lawns across Baton Rouge, Ascension and Livingston. The company has grown, but the standard has not changed: treat every property carefully, explain what was done and never make a customer chase us for an answer.
We are lawn-treatment specialists. That focus gives our team more time to understand local turf, improve application quality and catch problems before they become expensive.
Our programs account for South Louisiana heat, humidity, rainfall, soil conditions and the specific pressures affecting centipede, St. Augustine, zoysia and bermuda.
Professional equipment, measured application rates and weather-aware timing help us treat the lawn precisely while protecting beds, hardscapes and surrounding plants.
Service reminders, gate and pet notes, clear visit updates and a responsive local office mean you always know when we came, what we did and what comes next.
Healthy turf takes consistent care. Our eight-round program follows the lawn through the year and adjusts to the conditions we see at each visit.
You should never have to wonder what is happening with your lawn. Our process is built to keep the service simple and the expectations clear.
We learn about the property, identify the turf and understand the issues you want solved.
Your quote is based on the lawn and the services that make sense—not a generic package full of extras.
Our technicians apply the right products at calibrated rates with care around the entire property.
We share what we found, explain what to expect and adjust future visits as conditions change.
Real people answer your questions, schedule your visits and care for your property. We are proud of the team—and the reputation—we are building here at home.
Sets the standard for service, team development and the long-term care of every customer.
Leads precise field applications and helps keep treatment quality consistent from lawn to lawn.
Brings careful application work, close attention and dependable service to every route.
Keeps scheduling, communication and customer support organized and moving smoothly.
Extreme heat, heavy rainfall, humidity, compacted soil and long growing seasons create challenges that national, one-size-fits-all schedules can miss.
Our plans are built around the turf and conditions we see every day.
Careful nutrition and well-timed weed control that respects this grass's lower-input needs.
Season-aware treatments with attention to insects, disease pressure and summer stress.
Balanced fertility and proactive monitoring for the fungus pressure created by heat and humidity.
Consistent nutrition and strategic weed-prevention timing for dense, actively growing turf.
Tell us where you are and what you want to improve. We’ll measure the lawn and provide a clear, no-pressure quote built for your property.

STORY ========================================================= -->
Our story

Built on service, responsibility and doing the job right.

Dereck Palermo founded Grow Green Weed Control with a straightforward idea: South Louisiana homeowners deserved reliable lawn care from a local team that would take ownership of the result.

As a professional firefighter, Dereck built the company around the same habits his other career demands—show up prepared, pay attention to details, communicate clearly and be accountable when people count on you.

What began as one local owner serving his neighbors has grown into a dedicated team caring for hundreds of lawns across Baton Rouge, Ascension and Livingston. The company has grown, but the standard has not changed: treat every property carefully, explain what was done and never make a customer chase us for an answer.

“I want every customer to feel like they know who is caring for their lawn—and that our team genuinely stands behind the work.”
Dereck Palermo, Owner
  • Locally owned and operated
  • Licensed and insured
  • No long-term contracts
THE SPECIALIST DIFFERENCE ========================================================= -->
Why Grow Green

We do not try to be every kind of lawn company.

We are lawn-treatment specialists. That focus gives our team more time to understand local turf, improve application quality and catch problems before they become expensive.

Louisiana lawn expertise

Our programs account for South Louisiana heat, humidity, rainfall, soil conditions and the specific pressures affecting centipede, St. Augustine, zoysia and bermuda.

Careful, calibrated treatments

Professional equipment, measured application rates and weather-aware timing help us treat the lawn precisely while protecting beds, hardscapes and surrounding plants.

Communication you can count on

Service reminders, gate and pet notes, clear visit updates and a responsive local office mean you always know when we came, what we did and what comes next.

RESULTS ========================================================= -->
What better service looks like

A program—not a random spray.

Healthy turf takes consistent care. Our eight-round program follows the lawn through the year and adjusts to the conditions we see at each visit.

  • We inspect before treating.Technicians look for weeds, turf stress, disease pressure and conditions that may change the plan.
  • We document the visit.You receive useful information about the service—not a vague “we were here” notification.
  • We keep watching the lawn.Progress is tracked from visit to visit so emerging issues can be addressed at the right time.
PROCESS ========================================================= -->
Our approach

Clear from the first quote to every treatment after it.

You should never have to wonder what is happening with your lawn. Our process is built to keep the service simple and the expectations clear.

01

Measure & understand

We learn about the property, identify the turf and understand the issues you want solved.

02

Build the right plan

Your quote is based on the lawn and the services that make sense—not a generic package full of extras.

03

Treat with precision

Our technicians apply the right products at calibrated rates with care around the entire property.

04

Report & adjust

We share what we found, explain what to expect and adjust future visits as conditions change.

TEAM ========================================================= -->
The people behind the service

Meet your local Grow Green team.

Real people answer your questions, schedule your visits and care for your property. We are proud of the team—and the reputation—we are building here at home.

Dereck Palermo

Owner

Sets the standard for service, team development and the long-term care of every customer.

Kyle Robison

Lead Technician

Leads precise field applications and helps keep treatment quality consistent from lawn to lawn.

Gavin Broussard

Technician

Brings careful application work, close attention and dependable service to every route.

Moses Sunseri

Office Administrator

Keeps scheduling, communication and customer support organized and moving smoothly.

LOCAL EXPERTISE ========================================================= -->
Made for lawns here

South Louisiana is not an easy place to grow great turf.

Extreme heat, heavy rainfall, humidity, compacted soil and long growing seasons create challenges that national, one-size-fits-all schedules can miss.

Our plans are built around the turf and conditions we see every day.

Serving Baton Rouge, Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Walker, Zachary, Central and nearby communities.
Centipede

Careful nutrition and well-timed weed control that respects this grass's lower-input needs.

St. Augustine

Season-aware treatments with attention to insects, disease pressure and summer stress.

Zoysia

Balanced fertility and proactive monitoring for the fungus pressure created by heat and humidity.

Bermuda

Consistent nutrition and strategic weed-prevention timing for dense, actively growing turf.

FINAL CTA ========================================================= -->
Ready for a better lawn?

Let’s take a closer look at your property.

Tell us where you are and what you want to improve. We’ll measure the lawn and provide a clear, no-pressure quote built for your property.

Start My Free Quote Call (225) 461-3199 Fast response · Local team · No long-term contracts
